card.name: Forbidden lines and contraindicated
card.fires_on: Two settings: the word "line" or "cross" in the idiom of forbidden limits (red line, lines not to cross), and the middle of "contraindicated" or "Contraindications" in drug labels.

modes.label: Red-line idiom
modes.description: Words in phrases about forbidden limits or taboos, such as red line or a line one cannot cross.
modes.example: has been cited as a "red<< line>>" for robust action by the United States

modes.label: Inside contraindicated
modes.description: The "ain" or "train" piece in the middle of contraindicated or Contraindications in label text.
modes.example: CAPLYTA is contr<<ain>>dicated in patients with history of hypers

card.writes: Promotes words meaning taboo, forbidden and red line, so it pushes toward ideas of prohibition.
card.plain: It fires on the idea of something forbidden, in red-line phrases and inside the word contraindicated.
